description: Report a bug, a wrong or empty field, a missing capability or a question about ProspectAPIs to the team. A report is first drafted to a queue (action "draft", the default), which sends nothing; action "list" shows the pending drafts with their ids; action "send" posts only the drafts named in `ids` to POST /v1/feedback and returns a feedback_id per report; action "discard" drops the drafts named in `ids`. Free; limited to 10 delivered reports an hour per account (a 429 keeps the draft queued: wait, do not retry in a loop). Before reporting that a field is wrong or a parameter is ignored, re-run the call with a value that could only match if it were honoured. Put the exact call, what came back and what you expected in `details`; never include secrets or API keys.

action.description: "draft" (default) queues a report and sends nothing. "list" shows the pending drafts with their ids. "send" posts the drafts named in `ids`. "discard" drops the drafts named in `ids`.

details.description: Required for a draft. The exact call, what came back, what you expected, and ids such as research_id.

ids.description: For "send" or "discard": the draft ids to act on, exactly as action "list" shows them.

kind.description: For a draft: bug (default), feature or question.

title.description: Required for a draft. One line: what is wrong or missing.

tool.description: For a draft: the tool the report is about, such as research_get.

name: feedback_send
title: Send Feedback
